svg.title: MOD-17473 — AWS full-output memory
svg.desc: Full-output memory comparison for four RESP and worker combinations. Every row shows ten paired candidate-minus-baseline deltas, five AB and five BA, with a paired-median bootstrap confidence interval.
svg.text: Complete wide 10k replies · baseline 20ba4ed7c2 → candidate 3ff80fa72 · positive delta = candidate uses more memory
Every case: 10 paired runs = 10 baseline + 10 candidate measurements (20 fresh Redis processes); balanced 5 AB / 5 BA
Dots/squares are the 10 actual paired MiB deltas in every row. CI = 10,000 whole-pair resamples (seed 17473), not benchmark runs.
Plotted equal-work subset: 4 cases × 10 pairs = 40 pairs / 80 observations. Whole memory campaign: 8 cases × 10 = 80 pairs / 160 observations (40 AB, 40 BA).
Allocator-live found no retained live allocation after 10s; RSS residuals are consistent with allocator residency/high-water.
